phases.name: Workspace Structure
phases.goal: Establish shared execution control layer. All agents read from this before any execution.

segments.name: Execution Registry
acceptance_criteria: File exists at execution/registry.json
All phases and segments are listed
Each segment has: id, status, assigned_agent, depends_on, file_scope, acceptance_criteria

segments.name: Lane Definition Map
acceptance_criteria: File exists at execution/lanes.json
All 6 lanes defined with directory mappings
No directory overlap exists between any two lanes
Every segment in registry maps to exactly one lane

segments.name: Agent Assignment Rules
acceptance_criteria: File exists at execution/agents.md
Single-lane ownership rule is stated
Registry-check-before-execution rule is stated
Out-of-lane file modification is explicitly prohibited

phases.name: Token System
phases.goal: Establish canonical design tokens as the shared foundation. No styling work in any other lane is valid until this phase passes.

segments.name: Theme File Extraction
acceptance_criteria: src/theme/theme.css created
src/index.css contains zero CSS custom property declarations (--*)
src/index.css imports src/theme/theme.css via @import
All existing tokens from index.css are present in theme.css without loss

segments.name: Token Completion
acceptance_criteria: Spacing token scale present: --space-0 through --space-24 in 4px increments
Animation duration tokens present: --duration-fast (150ms), --duration-normal (250ms), --duration-slow (350ms)
Easing tokens present: --ease-enter, --ease-exit with cubic-bezier values
Role accent tokens present: --color-roleAccent-owner, promoter, dj, door, guest
Blur abstraction tokens present: --blur-sm, --blur-md, --blur-xl
Theme identity tokens present: --theme-id, --theme-mode
Olive color palette tokens present
Purple accent token present: --color-accent-purple (#A78BFA)

segments.name: Token Alignment
acceptance_criteria: Card border radius: --radius-card = 24px (outer), --radius-card-inner = 16px (inner)
Tailwind borderRadius.card = 24px, borderRadius.card-inner = 16px
Gold palette values identical to Velari: light #D4B896, DEFAULT #C4A35A, dark #8B7355, muted #6B5B4F
Olive palette added to Tailwind config: light #7A8B4A, DEFAULT #5D6B35, dark #3D4A2E, muted #2E3A22
Shadow token names match Velari: --shadow-glass, --shadow-glassHover
Glass tint value: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)
Glass opacity: 15%
Role accent color values match Velari exactly

phases.name: Theme Runtime
phases.goal: Enable runtime token injection so the design system is dynamic, not static.

segments.name: Theme Provider
acceptance_criteria: ThemeProvider component exists and accepts initialTheme prop
ThemeProvider injects CSS variables onto document :root at runtime
ThemeTuningProvider exists and wraps ThemeProvider
src/theme/index.ts exports both providers
Default theme is classy-dark

segments.name: Root Integration
acceptance_criteria: main.tsx imports ThemeProvider and ThemeTuningProvider from src/theme
Provider stack order: QueryClientProvider > ThemeProvider > ThemeTuningProvider > App
initialTheme prop set to classy-dark
App renders without console errors related to theme

phases.name: Shell Architecture
phases.goal: Replace traditional website layout with Velari app-shell model.

segments.name: GlobalSurface
acceptance_criteria: Component exists at src/layout/GlobalSurface.tsx
Enforces max-w-[430px] on mobile
Enforces sm:max-w-[640px] on tablet
Enforces lg:max-w-[768px] on desktop
Container is centered with mx-auto
Background fills viewport edge-to-edge, content is constrained
Renders GlobalHeader and AnimatedPortalShell as children

segments.name: Header Replacement
acceptance_criteria: GlobalHeader.tsx created at src/layout/GlobalHeader.tsx
GlobalHeader renders inside GlobalSurface, not independently
GlobalHeader accepts role context (placeholder if auth not yet wired)
Navbar.tsx is removed or marked deprecated — not rendered anywhere
No import of Navbar.tsx exists in App.tsx or Shell.tsx

segments.name: BottomNav
acceptance_criteria: BottomNav.tsx exists at src/layout/BottomNav.tsx
Component is rendered in App.tsx outside of Routes — always visible
Uses fixed or sticky positioning at viewport bottom
Tabs are role-aware placeholders (can default to guest tabs until auth is wired)
Does not render inside any page component

segments.name: AnimatedPortalShell
acceptance_criteria: Component exists at src/layout/AnimatedPortalShell.tsx
Wraps page content with entrance animation using Framer Motion
Applies pt-2 pb-24 to clear GlobalHeader and BottomNav
Animation uses CSS variable tokens for duration and easing
All pages render inside AnimatedPortalShell — not directly in routes

segments.name: App Restructure
acceptance_criteria: App.tsx imports and uses GlobalSurface, GlobalHeader, AnimatedPortalShell, BottomNav
Shell.tsx is removed or deprecated — no longer rendered
Footer.tsx is removed — replaced by BottomNav
Public routes render without GlobalSurface wrapper
Protected routes render inside ProtectedRoute > GlobalSurface
BottomNav is rendered at App root level, outside Routes
Route structure matches Velari public/protected split pattern

segments.name: Auth Store
acceptance_criteria: authStore.ts exists at src/stores/authStore.ts
Store holds: user, profile, roles (array), activeRole, status, orgMemberships, activeOrgId, roleIntent
Status values: idle | loading | authenticated | unauthenticated | error
Role types defined: guest | owner | door | promoter | dj
Role priority ordering implemented
Computed values: isAuthenticated, isReady
Actions: login, logout, switchRole, switchOrg, setRoleIntent
Login action executes 7-step async pipeline matching Velari's order
Store uses Zustand persist middleware with localStorage
src/types/auth.ts defines RoleType, AuthState, Profile interfaces

segments.name: Auth Provider
acceptance_criteria: AuthProvider.tsx exists at src/providers/AuthProvider.tsx
Subscribes to Supabase onAuthStateChange
Handles: INITIAL_SESSION, SIGNED_IN, SIGNED_OUT events
5-second fallback timeout if no auth event fires
Shows loading UI during initialization
Exports useAuth() hook
Guards against double-initialization (React Strict Mode safe)
AuthProvider added to provider stack in main.tsx (LANE_AUTH owns main.tsx for this segment only — coordinate with LANE_THEME agent)

segments.name: ProtectedRoute
acceptance_criteria: ProtectedRoute.tsx exists at src/routes/ProtectedRoute.tsx
Checks authStore.isReady — shows loading spinner if false
Checks authStore.isAuthenticated — redirects to /login if false
Renders children only when authenticated and ready
Used in App.tsx to wrap all protected routes

phases.name: State System
phases.goal: Establish global UI state and server state architecture.

segments.name: React Query Setup
acceptance_criteria: queryClient.ts exists at src/lib/queryClient.ts
QueryClient configured with appropriate staleTime and retry settings
QueryClientProvider added to provider stack in main.tsx
useProducts hook migrated from useState/useEffect to React Query
No raw useState-based data fetching remains in hooks directory

segments.name: UI Store
acceptance_criteria: uiStore.ts exists at src/stores/uiStore.ts
Store holds: selectedProduct, showCartOverlay, selectedVenueId
Actions: selectProduct, openCartOverlay, closeCartOverlay, clearSelection
Cart modal open/close state is owned exclusively by uiStore
No page-level component holds cart open/close state locally

segments.name: Cart Store Migration
acceptance_criteria: cartStore.ts created at src/stores/cartStore.ts (replaces useCart.ts hook)
Zustand persist middleware applied to cartStore
Cart state survives full page reload
useCart.ts updated to import from cartStore
All existing cart functionality preserved: add, remove, updateQuantity, clear, total, itemCount

phases.name: Component System
phases.goal: Replace flat GlassCard system with Velari's two-layer container hierarchy.

segments.name: ModuleShell
acceptance_criteria: ModuleShell.tsx exists at src/components/shells/ModuleShell.tsx
Supports surface prop: glass | solid | flat
Supports density prop: compact | comfortable | spacious
Density values map to CSS spacing tokens
Renders loading state when isLoading=true
Renders empty state when isEmpty=true
Renders error state when error is provided
Supports optional header, action, and footer slots
No hardcoded spacing values — all spacing via CSS variable tokens

segments.name: VelariShell
acceptance_criteria: VelariShell.tsx exists at src/components/shells/VelariShell.tsx
Wraps ModuleShell with surface=flat
Applies glass-panel class
Supports variant prop: primary | secondary | compact | emphasized
Supports withAmbientGlow prop (applies velari-ambient-glow class)
Supports noPadding prop
Supports density prop (passed through to ModuleShell)
Visual output matches Velari reference system

segments.name: Component Migration
acceptance_criteria: Zero remaining imports of GlassCard.tsx across entire src/components directory
All locations previously using GlassCard now use VelariShell or ModuleShell with appropriate surface type
GlassCard.tsx either deleted or marked as @deprecated with no active usages
ProductCard uses VelariShell with appropriate variant
OrderConfirmation uses VelariShell
GSAP import removed from all component files — animations use Framer Motion only
No direct cubic-bezier or duration values in component files — all use CSS variable tokens

segments.name: Overlay System
acceptance_criteria: Cart.tsx is rendered in App.tsx at root level — not inside any page component
Cart visibility is controlled exclusively by uiStore.showCartOverlay
Cart open/close triggers are removed from all page and product components
Pages trigger overlay via uiStore.openCartOverlay() action only
Cart renders as root-level portal (createPortal or equivalent)
CartPage.tsx (/cart route) remains as full-page fallback view

phases.name: Routing System
phases.goal: Align routing architecture with Velari: lazy loading, error boundaries, Suspense fallbacks.

segments.name: Lazy Loading
acceptance_criteria: All page-level components imported via React.lazy() in App.tsx
Zero direct (non-lazy) page imports remain in App.tsx
Each lazy import wrapped in React.Suspense with RouteLoadingFallback
Bundle inspection confirms code-splitting is active (separate chunks per page)

segments.name: Suspense + Fallback
acceptance_criteria: RouteLoadingFallback.tsx exists at src/components/RouteLoadingFallback.tsx
Fallback UI is a centered spinner using Velari spinner pattern: border-2 border-white/20 border-t-white/80 rounded-full animate-spin
All Suspense boundaries in App.tsx use RouteLoadingFallback
Fallback renders correctly inside the constrained GlobalSurface viewport

segments.name: Error Boundaries
acceptance_criteria: ErrorBoundary.tsx exists as a React class component at src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx
ErrorBoundary wraps the entire route tree in App.tsx
Error state renders a user-facing message inside GlobalSurface (not a blank screen)
ErrorBoundary resets on route navigation
No unhandled React rendering errors can escape to a blank screen
